europe_now.title: France Restricts Crowd Control Gear Amid Unrest
europe_now.summary: Authorities in France have suspended the use of stun grenades at student demonstrations following an incident where a participant suffered severe injury. Meanwhile, government officials continue to face nationwide protests and growing political tension regarding economic policy and security measures.

europe_now.title: Russian Missile Attack Hits Residential Block
europe_now.summary: A lethal Russian missile strike has impacted a residential apartment building in Ukraine, resulting in numerous fatalities including children who were asleep at the time. The incident underscores the ongoing severe security crisis and civilian toll in the region.

top_stories.title: French Student Demonstrations and Official Reaction
top_stories.summary: High school and university students across France have staged continuous demonstrations to demand increased education funding and address national debt issues. The government responded by suspending specific crowd control munitions after a protester was severely injured during the ongoing unrest.
